# <Feature / Subsystem> — Design

- **Status:** Draft | Agreed | Implemented
- **Date / Author:**

> A design / tech-spec for a feature or subsystem (lives in `architecture/`). Capture the WHY —
> the scenarios and considerations — not just the final shape. Hard decisions become ADRs.

## Purpose / Goals
<What this must achieve and why; the user/operator need it serves.>

## Scenarios & considerations
<The situations, edge cases, and constraints driving the design. This is the high-value part:
record the reasoning so the design stays re-derivable and non-contradictory.>

## Options considered
<The alternatives weighed, with their trade-offs.>

## Decision / Design
<The chosen design. Link the ADR(s) it produces for the hard, standalone decisions.>

## Open questions
<What is still undecided. When resolved, move the answer into the design or an ADR.>
